license_note: The file carries no licence or SPDX line. The FEM repository attributes its bundled example meshes to The Newton Developers under Apache-2.0 (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and the README of its assets folder). No upstream location is recorded. The shape is a film character.
frame_note: The header says upAxis Z while the figure's height runs along y (head +y, belly +z, arm span along x). The loader follows the header and applies no rotation: the body is read lying on its back, belly up.
use: Scale 0.135 and placement are applied at load (examples/incision/_baymax_body.py); the file is not edited.
